scope: Offline DOE material and publication reuse; no target calls or historical run/replay executions
changes: Reuse the checked propagation owner and freshly computed review during DOE publication; external saved reads still validate results and references.
Bind incoming annotation to its verified owner by canonical identity instead of recompiling it on downstream reads.
Reuse one demand target index across sensitivity result validation.
Use the propagation unchanged-input helper before commit to retain upstream identity and artifact checks.

tests.command: python -m pytest tests/doe/test_verified_material_reuse.py tests/doe/test_formal_runner.py tests/doe/test_run_integrity.py tests/doe/test_demand_joint_material.py tests/doe/test_demand_provenance_v3.py tests/doe/test_sensitivity_engine.py -q --disable-warnings
tests.covered: One-load publication, exact restored outputs, changed upstream prevents commit, no downstream compiler call, candidate substitution and bool/int mutation rejected, shared index, saved tampering, dependency changes, explicit fresh fixture replay, source/Task consistency and supported/unresolved sensitivity conclusions

limits: Timings are one synthetic fixture measurement with shared current dependencies, not GA4 performance evidence.
Generation prompts, semantic engine rules, seven-call workflow and historical artifacts are unchanged by this DOE patch.
Saved external reads and fresh fixture replay retain validation; this patch does not claim semantic equivalence to source or improved source coverage.
